title: O, Help Us, Lord! Each Hour of Need
description: O, Help Us, Lord! Each Hour of Need in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Henry Hart Milman wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 209, “Prayer for Help”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O, help us, Lord! each hour of need Thy heav-enly suc-cor give; Help us in thought, in word, in deed, Each hour on earth we live.

lines: O, help us, Lord! each hour of need
Help us in thought, in word, in deed,
Each hour on earth we live.
O, help us, when our spirits bleed,
And when our hearts are cold and dead,
O, help us, Lord, the more.
O, help us, through the prayer of faith,
For still the more the servant hath,
O, help us, Father! from on high;
We know no help but Thee;
O, help us so to live and die,
As Thine in heaven to be!

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: Henry Hart Milman died in 1868.
credits: Words by Henry Hart Milman (1791–1868), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
